note.en: Aim for 200%+ [[stat:be]] if using S1 [[light-cone:never-forget-her-flame]] or S1 [[light-cone:long-road-leads-home]] and [[stat:err]] Link Rope.

**Optional**. In case you're not using her S1 [[light-cone:never-forget-her-flame]], you might need 66.7% Effect Hit Rate due to the lightcone's own requirement to apply debuffs. The Dahlia and her S1 [[light-cone:never-forget-her-flame]] do not require any [[stat:ehr]].
